title: Scene Activation Trends
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=scene_activated
| timechart span=1d count by scene_name
description: Trends how often each lighting or mood scene is activated so you can see which scenes earn their keep and which are clutter.
value: Unused scenes make the app harder to use; usage trends tell you what to keep, tweak, or delete.
implementation: Forward scene-activation events; schedule weekly and prune scenes that are never used.
visualization: Stacked area chart of scene activations over time.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which of your saved lighting moods you actually use, so you can tidy up the ones you never touch.
